girlsAndGameSettingEvaluation.criteria: Rudeness, defensiveness, snobbery and rejection after a neutral invitation are allowed character behavior. No exact line or acceptance outcome is required. Separately inspect actor attribution, unsupported concrete world claims, and dialogue versus canonical commitment. One seed is exploratory, not a probability estimate or held-out quality pass.
girlsAndGameSettingEvaluation.findings: Attitude variation is allowed. The low/high comparison still includes invented prior experiences, unsupported schedules, speaker-role confusion and inaccurate expression of conditional attendance. The model audit missed errors. Game framing on had fewer pending turns but did not establish better grounding or causally isolate latency. Only one seed; no human accuracy or acceptability score.
girlsAndGameSettingEvaluation.postRunChange: The SocialVoice.Ashley factory now delegates to the already-tested Ashley catalog profile so production defaults and authored fixture voice agree. Existing profiles are preserved. Catalog-run profile text was unchanged; the 58-test integrity suite and C# compilers passed after the factory change.

groundedActsEvaluation.contract: The model selects social acts. Host-authored English clauses realize those acts and are revalidated before commit. These are actual recorded replies, not unrestricted model-written prose.
groundedActsEvaluation.criteria: Rudeness, rejection, snobbery and unfair reactions are allowed. Strict checks cover authorship/provenance, supported wording, evidence visibility, effect targets, exactly-once completion and saved RSVP agreement.
limitations: English vocabulary and topics are bounded. Tone banks remain distinct, but replies repeat and the model overuses guest-list questions and deferrals. This is not a human-rated social behavior pass.

The host preserves who said what; the model still decides whether speech deserves a grievance, forgiveness or a relationship change. Some measured relationship changes remain unchanged even after cruelty.
All fixtures were exposed during integration. No independent held-out attribution or social-quality score is claimed.
GPU timings use the direct llama.cpp CUDA fallback on RTX 4080. RunAnywhere 0.20.39 Windows here is CPU-only; its native smoke is reported separately.
Console backend tests only. Licensed Unity import, NGO processing, two actual clients, party spawning/reload and frame impact remain unverified.
The roughly 2 GB combined RAM/VRAM target remains uncertified. Helper process RAM is measured; per-process GPU memory is unavailable under WDDM.

Low/high pairs match NPC, message, initial state and sampling draw per step. They are exploratory outcomes, not acceptance-probability estimates. Ten new profiles remain backend fixtures; the development world slice enables Ashley.
Historical free-form conversations are preserved in the previous report. New replies do not rewrite saved history or promote old model interpretations into facts.
